description:
Dec. 27-31, 2026 @ West Prince Curling Club

The Trials will qualify 1 mixed doubles team to represent PEI at the 2027 Canada Games in Quebec City, QC.

All team members must be members in good standing with a Curl PEI member curling club.

Additional eligibility requirements may apply - visit [Canada Games](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1awk9Rw6JIY-M1TbnQf8LTSK-6U6qCXqa/view) for details.

Communications will be sent to one team contact, as listed in the registration form, the team contact is responsible for sharing the information with the entire team.

Please be advised that all team coaches are expected to satisfy the mandatory qualifications outlined in [Curling Canada's Canada Winter Games Coaching Requirements](https://www.curling.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Canada-Winter-Games-Coaching-Requirements-EN.pdf) prior to the the event. Please ensure coaches have completed their membership [here] (https://pe.curling.io/en/products/11071-2026-27-coach-membership).
